work.title: Review variance and stdev implementation
work.result:
APPROVE: commit 54f85d47eb6b588252f600c1a76c96530b58dad2.

variance(xs) is the population variance: materializes xs, raises ValueError("variance of empty sequence") when empty, then sum((x - mean)^2) / n. The textbook series [2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9] is exactly 4 (sample variance would be 32/7), so the divisor is n.

stdev(xs) is variance(xs) ** 0.5, so empty input raises the same ValueError and a constant series is 0.

Follows mean(): list() so generators work, ValueError on empty, true division. Tests cover the population example, a fractional case (assertAlmostEqual on 2/3 and its square root), single-value and constant series, generators, and empty list plus empty iterator for both functions.

python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 7 tests, OK.
